title: Nuke build tests
description: The Nuke build tests in `build.tests/ViceSharp.Build.Tests.csproj` run through `BuildTest` on every host (PLAN-NUKETESTS-001). Traceability: TR-BUILD-001 ac-10, ac-11, ac-12; TR-PLAT-001 ac-8.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The 13 user-local deployment cases pass on Linux through `BuildTest` and prove TR-BUILD-001 ac-10 and ac-11.
The completion-manifest cases pass on every host through `BuildTest`.
The placement guards of PLAN-NUKETESTS-001 step 2 pass.
The Windows `BuildTest` run selects no Linux-host case and reports the excluded count.
